services.name: River Cruise
services.desc: Cruise the Chicago River and Lake Michigan and experience the city’s epic skyline aboard our family-friendly narrated tours. Dazzle your guests with a fabulous yacht for a stunning private party along Chicago’s beautiful riverwalk and spectacular lakefront. Where are the pet parents who count down to dressing up their dog every Halloween? This one’s for you! Our 2026 Howl-O-Ween Canine Cruise is back, setting sail the second and third weekends of October. Bring your pup in costume (humans can join the fun too!) for a 90-minute river and lake cruise featuring lively city highlights from our tour guide, pumpkin-flavored dog treats, and prizes for the best-dressed dogs. If you’re searching for a unique boat wedding venue in Chicago, the Fair Lady offers a private yacht experience unlike any other. Perfect for a wedding, corporate event, or breakfast cruise, a Fair Lady charter ensures your guests enjoy the best of the city. Unwind in our air-conditioned interior salon featuring large panoramic windows or take in the Chicago skyline from the roof deck of this spectacular vessel. 3-hour cruise minimum,
